Monitoring Serum Bisoprolol Concentrations in Patients With Heart Failure With Reduced Ejection Fraction: Results of a Pilot Study From Routine Health Care. Bisoprolol is a second-generation, highly selective beta-1 adrenergic receptor antagonist with various beneficial effects in patients with heart failure. Interindividual variability in response to bisoprolol is known, and finding the optimal dose for individual patients with heart failure is still challenging.
